context:
Goal: main moves only by pull request, in every repo.
Problem (rule): banchi's pre-push hook refuses a push to main, but the shared guard asks only on a forced or deleting push, and branch protection lets an admin token through while enforce_admins is false.
Based on (incident): banchi, 5 pushes to main (plan, banchi row 17).
Based on (read): hooks/guard_push_delete.py push_verdict allows any unforced push (main da8d8073).
Based on (read): step protect-enforce-admins (PR #1113) sets enforce_admins true for new repos only.
Departs from: shared push guard, which allows a plain push to main — it asks first.

options.gain: Rule git-main-only-by-pr is checked before the push in every repo, whatever each repo's protection says.
options.how: The shared push guard asks on an unforced push whose destination is the default branch; banchi removes its own pre-push refusal.
options.label: Ask in the shared guard
options.lose: A rare deliberate push to main needs your typed yes.

options.gain: One home for the rule, on the server.
options.how: Delete banchi's hook; protection with enforce_admins true refuses the push on GitHub.
options.label: Rely on branch protection
options.lose: Repos whose protection is not yet fixed stay open to the mistake.

options.gain: No change to the shared guard.
options.label: Keep it in banchi only
options.lose: Other repos have no client-side check.

ref: docs/plans/child-guard-promotion.md on PR #1119 (ea66d8e), owner question 4, banchi row 17
title: Should the shared push guard ask before a plain push to main?
why: Five incidents in one repo; the check is cheap and does not depend on each repo's protection.
